register.labelZh: PAY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: PAY 片語動詞可以表示把錢存入戶口、支付款項、歸還借款或清還整筆債務。；pay for something 表示某人因先前的行為而承受後果;pay somebody back 則可以表示報復某人。；pay off 可以表示努力、計劃或冒險最終帶來成功。；這些片語動詞常見於銀行、保險、貸款、賬單、工作、爭執,甚至繩索和安全線等情境。
register.summaryEn: PAY expressions can show money being deposited, paid out, returned or used to clear a debt completely. Pay for something shows that a person suffers because of an earlier action. Pay somebody back can describe taking revenge. Pay off is a useful way to say that effort, planning or a risk has brought success. These expressions commonly appear when people discuss banks, insurance, loans, bills, work, disagreements and even ropes or safety lines.
